title: Location status (integration)
description: POST /api/integration/location-status (integration token). After an accepted <ns>.report_location the integration tells the hub that the device shares its location – metadata only, never coordinates. The hub keeps location_shared and location_at in memory (admin UI, paired-client, client_status_updated) and stores battery_level like client_status. Best effort, not retried. 404 unknown client.
